title_zh: 美國內科醫師學會 AI 倫理立場：守住醫病關係、防止去技能化
title_en: ACP position paper on AI ethics in practice
summary_zh: 美國內科醫師學會（ACP）在 Annals of Internal Medicine 發表 AI 與醫療專業倫理的立場文件，Psychiatric Times 整理其重點：AI 應維護醫病關係，因為 AI 無法對病人負責或形成治療同盟；臨床人員須獨立評估 AI 輸出、主動偵測偏誤；避免訓練中與資淺人員的去技能化；傾向揭露 AI 使用；並建立涵蓋 AI 全生命週期的在地治理。
summary_en: Psychiatric Times summarizes an American College of Physicians position paper in Annals of Internal Medicine on AI ethics: AI should preserve the patient–clinician relationship because it cannot be accountable or form a therapeutic alliance; clinicians must independently evaluate outputs and detect bias, guard against deskilling (especially trainees), err toward disclosing AI use, and set up lifecycle-wide local governance.
evidence_note: 專業學會立場文件（共識性建議），非實證研究。

psych_concepts.note: 「不可盲從演算法建議」正是對自動化偏誤的提醒。

psych_concepts.name: 治療同盟
psych_concepts.note: 文件明言 AI 無法形成治療同盟，因此應保護醫病關係。

caution: 此為內科醫師學會文件，心理師應對照本身專業倫理守則與在地法規使用。

posts.title: Ethics and AI Use in Medical Practice: American College of Physicians Releases Position Statement
posts.content: Psychiatric Times 報導美國內科醫師學會（ACP）在 Annals of Internal Medicine 發表的 AI 倫理立場文件，重點包括維護醫病關係、臨床人員獨立判斷、防止去技能化、揭露 AI 使用與處理演算法偏誤。

related.title_zh: 加州簽署三項醫療 AI 法案：AI 只能當顧問、須處理演算法偏誤
related.title_en: California signs three healthcare AI bills
related.summary_zh: 加州州長簽署三項醫療 AI 法案：AB 1979 把 AI 在臨床照護中限於諮詢角色、不得執行需執照的臨床功能，並保護經由聊天機器人取得的病人健康資訊；SB 503 要求醫療 AI 開發者與使用者辨識、減輕並持續監測臨床決策支援系統的偏誤風險；AB 1609 禁止大型企業把客服聊天機器人包裝成真人。同時被否決的有 AB 2575 和處理 AI 心理治療的 SB 903。
related.summary_en: California's governor signed three healthcare AI bills: AB 1979 restricts AI to an advisory role in clinical care, bars it from performing licensed clinical functions and protects health information accessed through chatbots; SB 503 requires developers and deployers to identify, mitigate and monitor bias risks in clinical decision support; AB 1609 bars large enterprises from presenting customer-service chatbots as human. AB 2575 and the AI-in-psychotherapy bill SB 903 were vetoed.

related.title_zh: APA 健康提醒：AI 聊天機器人與身心健康 App 不能取代專業照護
related.title_en: APA health advisory on AI chatbots and wellness apps
related.summary_zh: 美國心理學會於 2025 年 11 月發布健康提醒，指出生成式 AI 聊天機器人與身心健康 App 不應被當作專業心理健康照護的替代品。APA 呼籲避免使用者產生不健康的依賴、為兒童青少年等高風險族群設計特別保護、禁止 AI 冒充持照專業人員，並要求科技公司提高透明度與預設保護隱私。
related.summary_en: In November 2025 the American Psychological Association issued a health advisory stating that generative AI chatbots and wellness apps should not replace professional mental health care. It calls for preventing unhealthy dependence, special protections for youth and other vulnerable groups, a ban on AI impersonating licensed professionals, and greater transparency and privacy by default.

related.title_zh: ACA 支持《Doctors Not AI Act》：保險 AI 不得取代臨床判斷
related.title_en: ACA backs Doctors Not AI Act to curb AI-driven insurance coverage denials
related.summary_zh: 美國諮商學會（ACA）宣布與另外 44 個心理健康與醫療組織共同支持兩黨法案《Doctors Not AI Act》（H.R. 10210）。該法案針對保險公司以 AI、演算法自動審查理賠、決定醫療必要性的做法設下防線：凡需臨床判斷的拒保決定，必須由具適當專長的持牌醫療人員做出，且須提高透明度並考量個人情況。
related.summary_en: On 2 Oct 2026 the American Counseling Association joined 44 other mental-health and medical organizations backing the bipartisan Doctors Not AI Act (H.R. 10210): insurers could not use AI alone to deny coverage, medical-necessity denials would need a licensed professional with appropriate expertise, with more transparency and individual circumstances considered.
